prompt: A high-fidelity desktop website UI mockup, landscape 16:9, of the HydroStep public boat library as a stitched-leather reading shelf. Other closed spines along the shelf show model names (HS-17, CC-18, HS-20) as embossed leather. A small metal finder tab on the shelf rail labeled "Find model". Product stamp "HYDROSTEP" on the leather header. Palette: saddle-tan leather #C4A882, linen #EDE6D9, walnut wood, deep brown ink. Desktop web UI, high craft skeuomorph.
